scope: Supplied course snapshots and supplied progress export only; unprovided records are not certified.

historyPolicy.preserveOriginalAttemptFields: all fields, including IDs, answers, scores, revisions, mode, and timestamps
historyPolicy.questionReferenceResolution: Use the versioned mapping; never overwrite original questionId or questionRevision.
historyPolicy.archivalRequirement: Retain the old course snapshot and available older snapshots so past answers can be interpreted.
historyPolicy.changedQuestionProgress: Keep earlier attempts visible as history; do not count old revisions as mastery of a revised question.
historyPolicy.newAttempts: Append new attempt IDs using the current course version and question revision.
historyPolicy.unprovidedProgress: If progress was omitted, validate each saved export before applying any migration.
